entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. Its three-tier loading system achieved a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and search, supported by Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that generates cited prose answers with explicit gap analysis. It builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without LLM calls and ensures data isolation through scoped institutional memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory provider that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It utilizes a custom vector graph engine with byte-level deduplication and automated fact extraction from sources like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agent memory to learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud services.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library provides the core FastAPI-based service logic for building stateful agents and serves as the foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It includes SDKs for session and peer management with support for local and managed deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database for local storage. It integrates with Hermes Agents via MCP, a Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context during operations.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and playbooks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost. It stores data in a local SQLite instance with FTS metadata and provides tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides Hermes Agent with private cross-session memory persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI functions as a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains a living semantic ontology with audit trails to raw sources. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy and offers portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML files on local disk using the open engram format. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval for multi-agent systems and MCP tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, employing a hybrid retrieval system that includes both BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system built on SQLite with FTS5 search, intentionally omitting vector databases and embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and utilizes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and includes features for contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files. It operates without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing DuckDB solely as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval through a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and stores data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that automates configuration for major coding agent clients using GGUF models.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first storage using SQLite and FTS5, integrating via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This plugin reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 tool ranking to select relevant schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only provider uses a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that uses Markdown files as a durable source of truth for coding agents. It features a migration workflow for importing project instructions and provides experimental adapters for various agent frameworks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for monitoring every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% transaction fees. It allows Hermes agents to settle payments directly to wallets using USDC and other stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to improve local capability routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing feedback to refine routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and sparse recall. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories using a local SourceVault server for indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation tool that uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned, diffable markdown memory without a database. It includes specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify and resolve stale or conflicting data.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution within coding harnesses and CLIs. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles to ensure software implementation remains efficient and functional.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for macOS and Windows that generates prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components. It features a coding-agent CLI that supports Hermes Agent alongside other OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, Mermaid, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles. It is designed for agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that integrates natively with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring how skills evolve collectively.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's docs directory for use with agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,153 skills with native support for Hermes Agent and Claude Code, plus ready-to-paste exports for other assistants. It includes specific integrations for platforms such as Slack, Telegram, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key to facilitate these YouTube-specific interactions.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite or Full modes. The workflow includes a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler for extracting runnable source files and automatically synchronizes edits from source files back into the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness uses a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes to manage work through durable trees and layered proof verification. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team operations.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This collection provides interoperable skills following the Agent Skills specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It includes specialized support for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and CRE/ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing installation guides and skills formatted in SKILL.md in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills facilitate FLUX image and video generation through specialized prompting guidelines and API integration. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video generation workflows using Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io spec. It links instructions directly to source lines and includes lifecycle tooling for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers a CLI and Python client for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features that utilize TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and recovery checkpoints for long-running processes.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a single Rust binary to execute AI tasks based on four core verbs. It prioritizes security by auditing cost ceilings and secret flows before spending tokens, while generating hash-chained receipts for verifiable history.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, utilizing a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system employs five layers, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It reduces token consumption and supports graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting and integration analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans from multiple linters with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows users to complete tasks via tapping while an agent manages system design through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and includes a risk-tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It features a Python goal engine for persistent state management and focuses on causal debugging and early-stop prevention.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios and real exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery commands to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through frontmatter validation. It monitors official specifications weekly to detect drift and uses CI-friendly exit codes to report profile mismatches.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It ensures reliability by gating all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators within a local Python environment.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures environment-specific path syntax is used and verifies existing project-compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and works across OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures that can be validated via a public API.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and facilitating human-approved payouts.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of tools provides capabilities for video-to-text conversion, OCR, and AI writing refinement for e-commerce materials. The skills are compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard, supporting both macOS and Linux.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from providers like OpenAI and DeepSeek. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need current development tools packaged for the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing for mobile agent interaction.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to interface with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on cloud-native state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on security by sandboxing the agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and cost monitoring accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of codebases to minimize token consumption and tool calls for coding agents. It features automatic synchronization upon file changes and provides structural extraction for languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to monitor token usage across various AI coding agents and IDEs. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from multiple coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from over 33 supported tools. It synchronizes data across multiple machines and offers detailed usage breakdowns by session, project, and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI facilitates UI development by providing design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers. It is compatible with any AI provider that supports markdown and integrates directly with agents like Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-created themes and skins to customize the terminal interface of the Hermes CLI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports human-readable identity handles and facilitates financial transactions using USDC and SOL on the Solana network.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including a Claude Code plugin for automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for local configurations, skills, and memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents to maintain project-specific custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It includes support for 29 community plugins, offering a zero-cost setup using free models.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on agent configurations and system prompts without using LLMs. It identifies vague tool descriptions or missing retry budgets and integrates directly with Hermes Agent verification hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool offers passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Operating as a local-first skill, this tool uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue. It utilizes a bounded JSON adapter and requires explicit approval for any external actions or writes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages without requiring API keys or accounts. It features adaptive turn-taking, barge-in capabilities, and a wake-word enabled open mic.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search functionality. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to add, delete, and search memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, serves as an all-in-one desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified management solution compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source coworking application that consolidates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. The platform features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms like Telegram and Discord. It tracks token consumption and execution history while storing session data in a local SQLite database.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for organizing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports native file dialogs, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 environments and live browser control governed by explicit user approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat and server file system browsing without the use of subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live quota burn for Codex and Claude across 14+ agent formats. It operates entirely locally with no telemetry, offering searchable transcripts and image browsing without uploading session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface connects to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a text-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard functions as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes with local or cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. Users can manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through an integrated file browser and task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE chat responses.
